msg.font.konsole_other_window: Saved font size %s. This %s window was not opened by Gnosis, so it cannot change on the spot. In a Konsole window opened from the Gnosis icon (or gnosis --new-terminal) it changes immediately.
msg.font.konsole_no_dbus: Saved font size %s. %s cannot be controlled over D-Bus (needs qdbus6, qdbus or gdbus); it is used from the next Gnosis window.
msg.font.kitty_no_remote: Saved font size %s. Remote control (allow_remote_control) is off in this %s window, so it cannot change on the spot. kitty windows opened by Gnosis apply it.
msg.font.unsupported: Saved font size %s. Gnosis cannot change the text size of this terminal (%s); adjust it in the terminal's own settings.
msg.font.status_live: In this %s window the font size changes immediately.
msg.font.save_failed: Could not save the font size: %s
msg.link.source_shown: Showing the Markdown source of links (run :GnosisLinkSource again to hide it)
msg.branch.added: Branch added (recorded in the parent's ChildBranch and the child's ParentBranch)
msg.branch.has_parent: Cannot add: "%s" already has a parent (ParentBranch). Current parent: "%s" (nothing was changed)
msg.branch.multi_parent: "%s" has several parents (%s). Not added because of this consistency error. Run :GnosisBranchCheck and fix it by hand (nothing was changed)
msg.branch.self: A note cannot be its own parent or child (nothing was changed)
msg.branch.nest_no_block: This note has no BranchGroup: (nothing changed)
msg.branch.nest_not_in_block: Select link lines inside BranchGroup: (nothing changed)
msg.branch.nest_cannot: Cannot nest any deeper (it is the first line, or already right under the line above; nothing changed)
msg.branch.unnest_cannot: Cannot move up any further (already at the top level; nothing changed)
msg.branch.cycle: Cannot add: the parent/child relation would form a cycle (nothing was changed)
msg.branch.index: index.md cannot be a Branch parent or child (nothing was changed)
msg.branch.dirty: "%s" has unsaved edits, so nothing was added. Save it and try again (nothing was changed)
msg.branch.conflict: Aborted because "%s" was changed elsewhere while adding (nothing was changed)
msg.branch.error: Could not add the Branch: %s (nothing was changed)
msg.branch.not_in_vault: Run this in a note of this vault
msg.branch.no_target: There is no link to a note that can be added
msg.branch.save_failed: Aborted because the current note could not be saved (nothing was changed)
msg.branch.check_ng: Gnosis: Branch problems found (nothing was rewritten)
msg.settings.choose_app_theme: Choose the color theme of the app (\A) (↑ ↓ Enter)
msg.theme_edit.name: Name:
msg.theme_edit.preview: Preview (nothing is saved and no note changes until you save)
msg.theme_edit.keys: ↑ ↓ item   ← → lightness   [ ] hue   - + saturation   Enter type a HEX (applied as you type)   Tab palette
msg.theme_edit.keys2: r reset this color   R reset all   n name   s save and use   Esc / q cancel
msg.theme_edit.confirm_discard: Discard the changes and go back?
msg.theme_edit.low_contrast: may be hard to read (4.5 or more is a good target)
msg.theme_edit.prompt_hex: %s color #rrggbb (Enter to accept, Esc to undo):
msg.web.app_theme_note: The colors of the app (\A) are chosen separately from the regular Vim colors. The default is a white background.
msg.web.editor_keys: Type a HEX (#rrggbb) directly, or use the color picker or the palette. ↑ ↓ move between rows ・ changes show in the preview at once ・ nothing is saved until "Save and use" ・ Esc cancels
msg.conflict.warn: Another window (or process) changed "%s". Your unsaved changes in this window were kept (backup: %s). Saving with :w overwrites their change (you will be asked). To load their change use :e! (your unsaved changes are already backed up)
msg.session.kept_unlocked: Another window (%s) is using this vault, so it was not locked: %s
msg.session.lock_refused: Not locked: another window (%s) is using this vault. To lock it anyway use :GnosisLock! (the other windows will no longer be able to use it)
msg.session.exclusive_refused: Cannot do this while another window (%s) is using this vault. Close the other windows and try again (nothing was changed)
msg.branch.one_parent_only: Only one note can be the parent (ParentBranch). Choose exactly one note (nothing was changed)
msg.write.unsaved: This note has unsaved changes, so the link target was not opened (save it, then :GnosisWNext opens it)
msg.write.opened: Opened the link target. The file name of "%s" is yanked (paste with p). No link was written automatically
msg.write.more: (%s more: open them one by one with :GnosisWNext)
msg.write.none: No more link targets to open for w
msg.context.migrated: Moved the Context to the new format (Context: at the top of the body) (%s links; no other line changed)
msg.context.nothing: This note has no old-style ### Context (nothing to migrate)
msg.context.dry: Notes with an old-style Context: %s (nothing was rewritten. Run :GnosisContextMigrate! all to migrate)
msg.context.confirm: Move the Context of %s notes in the vault to the new format (links are verified before and after writing). Continue?
